description: Sequencer engine with no outputs of its own, driving the 8 and 16 step sequencer channel, gate and trigger expanders placed to its right; four address inputs pick the step they play

inputs.text: The least significant bit of the step address: a level above 2V adds 1 to the step number, and leaving it unpatched shortens the addressed range
A level above 2V adds 2 to the step number, and leaving this jack unpatched shortens the addressed range
A level above 2V adds 4 to the step number, and leaving this jack unpatched shortens the addressed range
The most significant bit of the step address: a level above 2V adds 8 to the step number, which reaches steps 9 to 16 on a 16 step expander; the 8 step expanders ignore it
Each rising edge above 2V reads the four address inputs and moves the expanders to the step that address names

notes: there is no reset input, because the module holds no counter of its own; resetting belongs to whatever is generating the address signals
the Expansion entries narrow to the size already attached: with an 8 step expander to the right only the 8-step entries are offered, and with a 16 step one only the 16-step entries
menu: Add 8-step channel expander — places an 8 Step Sequencer Channel Expander to the right of this module
Add 8-step gate expander — places an 8 Step Sequencer Gate Output Expander to the right of this module
Add 8-step trigger expander — places an 8 Step Sequencer Trigger Output Expander to the right of this module
Add 16-step channel expander — places a 16 Step Sequencer Channel Expander to the right of this module
Add 16-step gate expander — places a 16 Step Sequencer Gate Output Expander to the right of this module
Add 16-step trigger expander — places a 16 Step Sequencer Trigger Output Expander to the right of this module
